dialogueLines.hi: Aangan ki rangoli adhoori reh gayi — mere rang ke matke kho gaye hain!
dialogueLines.en: The courtyard rangoli is unfinished — my pots of color have gone missing!

dialogueLines.hi: Har rang dharti se banta hai — haldi se peela, neel se neela, majith se laal!
dialogueLines.en: Every color comes from the earth — yellow from turmeric, blue from indigo, red from madder!
